motivation: In the already observed hidden-test cohort, all 13 eligible component-wise endpoints select the minimum two-nonidentity-block budget 9808. This follow-up holds topology and trainable parameter count fixed instead of interpreting the near-half budget ratio as a universal law.
H: With identical two-block topology, initialization, per-parameter update count and minibatch order, joint span-target fitting reduces held-out span NMSE relative to independent local-target fitting while selected fixed-arm test accuracy is noninferior within 3 percentage points.

T.eligibility: teacher validation accuracy >= 0.95, before any test evaluation
T.dataset: sklearn digits, same reused split as prior SmallViT; not a new dataset or unseen test set
T.teacher: SmallViT depth4 d32 heads4 mlp64, original 45 epochs, AdamW lr0.002 wd0.0001 batch128
T.calibration: first512 training examples; next256 training examples are span holdout; exactly the existing collect_span function

arms.local_pair: two width8 Blocks, 9808 parameters; separately fit X->M and M->Y
arms.joint_pair: same two width8 Blocks, 9808 parameters, exact copies of local_pair initial states; jointly fit X->Y through both modules
arms.direct_single: one width8 Block, 4904 parameters, directly fit X->Y; descriptive topology reference only

T.minibatch_schedule: epoch0..39 randperm(512), dedicated torch.Generator seed=model_seed+410000+epoch; identical order for all arms and both local modules
T.optimization: 40 epochs x8 batches, batch64, 320 AdamW updates per learned parameter, lr0.003 wd0.00001; separate optimizers for each local module, one optimizer for the joint pair; float32 unchanged
T.test_policy: No dimension or arm selection. Persist all fixed-arm state hashes and validation metrics before computing exactly four test evaluations: teacher and three fixed arms. Never use test for eligibility, tuning, reselection or stopping.
T.sample_size_and_stopping: Attempt all16 once; retain ineligible/missing/error records. No interim efficacy stopping. No replacement seeds. Technical verification/repetition adds zero scientific seeds.

D.order: first paired log2(joint_pair/local_pair holdout NMSE), then paired joint_pair-minus-local_pair test accuracy; percentile 2.5/97.5
D.coverage: all16 records present; >=12 eligible; all eligible arms finite, complete and provenance-valid
D.PASS: coverage and log2-NMSE-ratio CI upper<0 and test accuracy difference CI lower>-0.03
D.UNCERTAIN: adequate coverage but one or both preregistered effect gates not established; report which; not proof of inferiority
D.STOP: inadequate coverage, missing arm, nonpositive NMSE, nonfinite value, unequal paired initialization, wrong count or pre-freeze test access
D.descriptive_only: direct_single comparisons, validation accuracy, train loss, width8 floor discussion; no multiple-comparison-confirmatory claims

C: No objective benefit, task degradation despite NMSE improvement, eligibility instability, or residual differences dominated by fitting/generalization. The intervention changes supervision and second-module training inputs together; it cannot uniquely distinguish those mechanisms.
U: Conditional on one digits split, SmallViT family, boundary, width8 grammar, training schedule and recorded CPU environment. No minimal-budget, architecture-universal, runtime/memory/energy or whole-model compression claim. Numerical equality across hosts is not assumed. Intervals are over model seeds only.
outcome_changes_forbidden: Do not alter seeds, thresholds, widths, schedules, endpoints or bootstrap after outcomes. Any follow-up requires a separate prospectively locked experiment.
